subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.-----TRS.
description: First of two diagrams in T(IMP)M-32. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the vibrational realness of creative music reflecting the reality of black people, the use of this phenomenon will serve as a factor for aligning the functional arena of black creativity (regardless of period) under the American umbrella (and in this position, the black vibrational thrust will be inoperative). The net effect of this phenomenon will be a retardation of the sensibilities which allowed creative black music in America to be "ised," as well as the implications of what that retardation implies.' The crossing diagrams how affinity-postulation structurally meets transition at the retardation-of-sensibilities scale: AF-POST (affinity postulation — the form's actual postulating-from-affinity working) crossed with TRS (transition). AF-POST sits centrally with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY (information dynamics) leaves the main line toward the right, and ALT-DEF (alternative definitions) at upper-right branches from it, with (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) branching from ALT-DEF. TR (transformation) sits at the left on a line from the main line, carrying T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) at upper-left. ATTN (attraction) hangs from INFO-DY's line and carries ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism); POL-DY (political dynamics) sits centrally on a line that ends on ALT-C-PG's line, with CN-INFO (controlled information) branching from POL-DY. TRS sits at lower-left as partner-axis. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) at lower-right ends a horizontal line that leaves an unlabelled vertical from the main line, and AFI (affinity insight) sits at the bottom-center, hanging from SPT-DY's line.
